about: Container images the engine comparison run scans with both engines (golden-nightly.yml, job golden-containers). Each reference is pinned to the image index digest, which lists every platform; the runner (linux/amd64) reads its own platform from it. Digests were read with `docker buildx imagetools inspect <name>:<tag>` on 2026-10-13. Not part of the baseline gate.

images.name: container-nginx-alpine
images.why: Alpine (apk) packages on an end-of-life base (Alpine 3.17.7): many known vulnerabilities, and licences from the apk database. Trivy 0.71.2 listed 62 packages and 66 findings on linux/amd64.

images.name: container-debian-slim
images.why: Debian (deb) packages only. Their licences come from the copyright files, the case the BomLens os-licenses step handles. Trivy 0.71.2 listed 88 packages (85 with a licence) and 326 findings on linux/amd64.

images.name: container-node-slim
images.why: Language packages in an image: the npm bundled with Node.js 20.18.1 carries its own node_modules (Trivy 0.71.2 listed 204 npm packages and 38 findings on them), on top of 88 Debian 12.9 packages.
